delivered.statement: Turnover INR 17,184 crores with underlying sales growth 10%, highest in 13 quarters
Underlying volume growth 5%; total growth driven equally by volume and price
Absolute EBITDA grew 8% year-on-year to INR 3,947 crores; margin 23%
PAT before exceptional items grew 9% year-on-year to INR 2,731 crores
Adjusted PAT grew 11% year-on-year, reflecting quality of earnings and resilience
Delivered 14% USG, strongest performance in 3 years, driven by fabric wash
Segment delivered 12% USG driven by double-digit hair care and premium cosmetics
Delivered 7% USG; Horlicks and Boost both grew double-digit; Boost crossed INR 1,000 crore

themes: Portfolio transformation targeting higher-growth premium segments and emerging consumer categories
Calibrated pricing amid sustained commodity inflation with volume preservation priority
Supply chain resilience and agile manufacturing enabling service continuity in volatility
Multi-channel expansion: quick commerce 40-50% growth; GT rural-led resurgence; modern trade double-digit
AI and digital integration across value chain; 8 WEF Lighthouse designations across 6 sites
Market development in low-penetration categories: bodywash, premium cosmetics, ready-to-drink formats
risks: Global geopolitical tensions and volatile commodity/currency markets impact cost structure
Monsoon/El Niño uncertainty; agriculture 15% of GDP, impact capped at 50-60 basis points
Sustained palm oil and crude inflation pressuring Personal Care margins and volumes
Quick commerce competitive intensity and value player entry in liquid segments
